notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) HTTP-first only - Python requests with a browser User-Agent, no block encountered at any point. robots.txt (https://www.homecentre.com/robots.txt) allows User-agent: * (Allow: /) and explicitly lists Claude-Web/ClaudeBot/anthropic-ai with Allow: /, so both HTTP fetch and Chrome tiers would be permitted; HTTP tier alone was sufficient. TREE: built from the union of (1) robots.txt Sitemap: entry -> https://www.homecentre.com/ae/en/sitemap_categories.xml (656 category leaf URLs) and (2) the homepage's own rendered mega-menu links (431 /ae/en/c/... hrefs fetched from https://www.homecentre.com/ae/en/). Cross-referencing both sources revealed the sitemap contains a stale/orphaned duplicate category tree under 'kids-*' and a separate 'baby-nursery-*'/'baby-bathandcare-*' tree that are NOT present in the live mega-menu (which only links 'babyandkids-*' and 'baby-diapering/feeding/gear/infantactivity' for this content area). Per first-block/bad-slug guidance, only the live-nav-linked 'babyandkids-*' URLs were used for baby/kids nodes; the stale 'kids-*' and orphan 'baby-nursery-*'/'baby-bathandcare-*' duplicates were excluded even where they returned plausible (sometimes differing) counts, to avoid recording an unverified/non-canonical URL. Two live-nav leaf slugs (babyandkids-bathandstorage-storage-deskaccessories, babyandkids-bathandstorage-storage-jewelleryboxes) silently resolved to the PARENT aggregate page (h1 'Kids' Bath & Storage', nbHits=411) instead of their own leaf content - classic bad-slug symptom per brief warning - so both were dropped rather than fabricating a count; the working 'bedroom-clothesstorage-hangers' sitemap URL similarly returned a small/empty non-matching page (h1 unparsable, nbHits=0, not in live nav) and was dropped. QTY: for every recorded leaf, qty = nbHits field read from the Algolia 'searchData' block inside the page's __NEXT_DATA__ script tag (base64-decoded 'initialState' JSON) - this is the site's own server-rendered total-result count for that category, cross-checked against the page's <h1> to confirm it matches the requested node (per bad-slug guidance). No number was estimated, paginated/counted manually, or copied from a sibling/parent. EXCLUDED (Furniture, per storage.md sec.21/27 explicit-furniture-placement rule, not touched - Furniture.xlsx territory): furniture-bedroom-*, furniture-livingroom-*, furniture-office-*, furniture-storage-bedroomstorage/livingroomstorage/bathroomstorage/diningroomstorage (chest of drawers, bookcases, display cabinets, storage safes, laundry furniture), furniture-sofaandseating-ottomansbeanbagsandpoufs, babyandkids-roomfurniture-*, babyandkids-kidsbeds-*, babyandkids-nursery-wardrobes/cots/changers/feedingchairs/mattresses/toddlerbeds. EXCLUDED (Wall Decor / Decorative Home Accessories territory, not touched): household-decor-boxesandtrays (decorative boxes/trays, sibling of candleholders/vases/sculptures), household-walldecorandmirrors-*, babyandkids-decorandlighting-decor-*, household-storage-cosmeticorganizing-makeupmirrors (mirror, not storage). EXCLUDED (hardware/fixtures, neither Textile nor Storage per both rule files' explicit hardware carve-outs): household-windows-curtainrodsandaccessories-* (curtain rods/rings), household-bathandlaundry-shower-showercurtainrods, household-bathandlaundry-bathroomorganizing-toiletpaperholders/wallfixturesandhooks/laddersandstools, household-bathandlaundry-laundrysolutions-clothesdryerandrails/ironingboards, household-bathandlaundry-wastebinsandaccessories. EXCLUDED (apparel/footwear/pet/personal-carry/toys/general-merchandise, out of scope for both categories): household-bathandlaundry-bathlinen-bathrobesandslippers-slippers, household-travel-bags-*/luggage-* (personal luggage, not home storage per storage.md sec.6), household-kitchen-foodstorage-lunchbags, household-kitchen-foodstorage-oilandvinegar/saltandpeppershakers (Kitchen & Dining), all pets-*/toys-*/school-*/boys-*/girls-* nodes. EXCLUDED (mixed/ambiguous category pages where a single listing page combines a qualifying product type with a clearly non-qualifying one, so a clean qty could not be attributed - no aggregation per rule): household-cushionsandthrows-beanbags (Bean Bags=Furniture), household-cushionsandthrows-poufs (Furniture), babyandkids-beddingandwindows-bedding-floorcushionsandbeanbags ('Kids' Bean Bags & Floor Cushions' - textile floor cushions mixed with furniture bean bags on one listing page), household-homefitness-functional-yoga and household-rugsandcarpets-yogamats (yoga mats/accessories - not fabric-primary), household-rugsandcarpets-flooraccessories ('Rug Gripper' - accessory hardware, not a textile product itself), household-christmas-decorandtableware-cushions (seasonal/holiday collection page per rule 15, nbHits=2), kids-bathandstorage-bath-bathroomaccessories / babyandkids-bathandstorage-bath-bathroomaccessories and babyandkids-nursery-bathessentials (generic/mixed bath-accessory pages, no clear single primary textile product type).
